about.purpose: Check M6 of tools/check-patches.js (DESIGN.md §7.1): the research's 27 mastery spot checks plus the repo-bug fixes and decisions D3-D6, as assertions on the generated mastery datasets. Written from the research, not from the generator output.
sources: scratchpad patches/masteries-ddragon/discrepancies.json (repo bugs against DDragon / wiki / Riot notes)
DDragon mastery.json of the last build per patch (raw/mastery/mastery-<build>.json): the quoted strings
tools/fixtures/README.md (P0-A): the S1 Ardor '+#%' baseline bug

format.check: {id, what, page?: 'masteries', patch: <patch> | [<patch>...], tree?: 0-2 | 'offense'|'defense'|'utility' | 'ferocity'|'cunning'|'resolve', key?: <mastery key>, expect: {...}, origin, source}

expect (all optional, all must hold).absent: true: no mastery with this key (in this tree)
expect (all optional, all must hold).name / ranks / icon / tier / index: exact values; icon = classic `icon` or keystone `iconId` (as string); tier is 1-based (classic floor((index-1)/4)+1)
expect (all optional, all must hold).text:
{|'all'|'last': {contains: [..], notContains: [..], equals, matches: [regex]}}: the tooltip text the calculator draws at that rank (rankDesc[rank-1], else the desc/rankInfo template, else the keystone a/b/c collapse); compared after
-> space, tags dropped, whitespace collapsed
expect (all optional, all must hold).rankDesc: the normalized texts of every rank, in order
expect (all optional, all must hold).placeholders: false: no rank text still holds '#', '@var@', 'undefined' or 'NaN'
expect (all optional, all must hold).keysAbsent: [keys] none of them anywhere in the dataset (no `key` needed)
expect (all optional, all must hold).sameDataAs: <patch>: the payload equals that patch's payload (no `key` needed)
expect (all optional, all must hold).date: YYYY-MM-DD of the registry / listing entry
expect (all optional, all must hold).note: [regex...]: a change text in the listing record of the patch (data/patches/masteries.json) matches all of them, case-insensitive (D3: mechanics the tooltip leaves out go into the notes)
